scheme_name: Home Loan Interest Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Workers must be employed in the organized sector in Gujarat
Must have worked continuously with the same factory/company/organization for at least one year
Labour Welfare Fund contribution must be deposited with the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
Purchase price of the house must not exceed ₹30 lakhs
Loan tenure must be 15 years or more
Home loans must be taken from a Nationalized, Scheduled Bank or NBFC only
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of purchase document
benefits_summary: Provides a 3% interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹15 lakhs (or based on bank interest, whichever is lower) for eligible workers.
